subject: Marketplace listing: localized assets, support SLA edge cases
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acme.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing questions: localized assets + support windows

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the product overview earlier this week. We're prepping our AWS/GCP marketplace submissions and have a couple of edge-case questions before we upload assets:

1) Localized marketing assets: ACME wants to include Spanish and French storefront copy and screenshots. Are there any marketplace policy constraints (AWS / GCP) around localized screenshots that reference Redwood brand elements (logo lockups, product screenshots with Redwood watermark)? We want to avoid listing rejections.

2) Support SLA windows: our internal ops require a formal statement of supported hours by region. The marketplace listing requires an answer for "support hours" and a fallback routing plan when Redwood Dedicated is in a maintenance window. Can you confirm the precise wording we should use?

3) Trademarks & co-branding: in a co-sell listing we wanted to show an example joint architecture diagram with ACME logos and Redwood's. Any pre-approved co-brand copy or required disclaimers?

I've attached our draft storefront assets and a spreadsheet listing requested support times by timezone. Can your team confirm what will pass marketplace QC for AWS/GCP and if there's anything we should change now?

Attachments: [Attachment: acme_storefront_draft.zip (application/zip)], [Attachment: acme_support_windows.csv (text/csv)]

Appreciate a quick turnaround — aiming to submit by next Tuesday.

—
Lina Torres

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing questions: localized assets + support windows

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear list and the draft assets. Looping in Marcus (marketplace policy lead) and Monica (partner ops) so we can be explicit about wording and accepted artifacts.

Summary / immediate asks:
- Asset localization: short answer — localized screenshots are allowed, but marketplaces typically reject images that include non-redistributable third-party marks or masked/altered vendor marks. We should remove the watermark on product screenshots and supply separate localized copy files (strings + screenshots) rather than embedding localized text into a single image where possible.

- Support SLA statement: we should provide a concise support statement and a routing fallback. Example wording we use for other listings: "Standard business-hours support (M–F, 9:00–17:00 PT). 24/7 critical incident escalation through dedicated support contacts (see support routing policy)." If you need different hours for AP/EMEA, provide the timezone-specific hours and we will map them to the marketplace fields.

- Co-brand diagrams: marketplaces usually require written permission for third-party logos in listing screenshots. For co-brand diagrams, include a short caption: "Partner architecture — logos used with permission" and attach evidence of permission if possible.

Next steps: Marcus will confirm marketplace-specific constraints and Monica will map the CSV you sent into Redwood's support-window matrix to produce the final text for each marketplace. Expect a consolidated reply from us by Monday.

Best,

—
Tessa Morgan
Head of Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>

Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing questions: localized assets + support windows

Thanks — adding a few policy-specific notes from AWS/GCP QC experience (keeps it brief):

1) AWS Marketplace — image rules: no embedded promotional third-party trademarks unless you have signed permission. Screenshots with product UIs are fine but must not contain customer-identifying data. For localized text, supply both (a) localized copy files in a .po/.xliff or plain text, and (b) localized screenshots — do not burn localized text into images that also contain Redwood's watermark.

2) GCP Marketplace — packaging guidance: listing metadata fields are stricter about product descriptions exceeding allowed characters. Keep localized descriptions within the same field length (we can help chunk them). GCP also does a manual review on co-brand claims; a statement of permission is often requested.

3) Support routing / maintenance: for listings we recommend a short fallback clause: "If Redwood Dedicated capacity is unavailable due to scheduled maintenance, support requests will be routed to a shared support tier with a target response time of 4 hours for P1 incidents; critical escalations handled via on-call." That phrasing has cleared prior AWS reviews.

4) Evidence: marketplaces sometimes ask for artifacts during QC — signed permission letters for logos, screenshots in original source formats, and a one-page summary of support routing. Attach our brand guidelines and the support-window matrix we intend to send.

I'll attach the brand guidelines excerpt and a draft support-window matrix mapping to marketplace fields. Monica — can you produce the final three-line support statements for each region?

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_brand_guidelines_v2.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: support-window-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

—
Marcus Lin

Hi Lina — attaching the support-window matrix we've populated from your CSV and the three-region statements you can paste into each marketplace form. I've also annotated the asset checklist with notes on where to remove the watermark and which JPG/PNG to replace with source SVGs.

Paste-friendly support statements (examples):
- US region: "Business-hours support (M–F, 9:00–17:00 PT). 24/7 critical incident escalation via dedicated on-call; standard ticket response target: 4 hours for P1s."
- EMEA region: "Business-hours support (M–F, 09:00–17:00 CET). Critical incident escalation routed to on-call; standard ticket response target: 6 hours for P1s."
- APAC region: "Business-hours support (M–F, 09:00–17:00 SGT). Critical incident escalation routed to regional on-call; standard ticket response target: 6 hours for P1s."

Co-branding: please upload a signed logo use permission (simple PDF with ACME letterhead is fine). For the architecture diagram, we recommend a small caption: "Logos used with permission; diagram for illustrative purposes only."

I've attached the annotated matrix and a short checklist (see attachments). Once you confirm we will send the marketplace-ready ZIP with localized asset folders and the signed permission template for your legal team to sign.

Attachments: [Attachment: support-window-matrix.xlsx (updated)], [Attachment: asset-localization-checklist.txt (text/plain)]
